dialogue_texts: Marisa
Man, it's pitch black out here, but this red haze is making it look downright creepy.
Marisa
And why is all this mail still piling up?
Ah, My Majesty. Someone was supposed to deliver these hours ago.
Hiroyuki
By the way, I am Hiroyuki Shirogane. As the head of the Shirogane Manor, please allow me to accompany you.
Marisa
Yeah, yeah, glad to have ya, Shirogane-sama. But look who's crawling out of the woodwork.
Marisa
Hey, Kotori! You slackin' off on the job?
Kotori
Go away... Don't yell at me... If I just stop delivering... the mistakes stop too...
Marisa
Whoa, hold on. Her eyes are totally glazed over.
Marisa
Don't tell me she's caught the glohm that everyone's whispering about?
Kotori
The dark is so quiet... No letters to lose, no angry faces.
Kotori
The Order told me... a closed heart can never be hurt.
Hiroyuki
My Majesty, please be cautious! The glohm feeds on resentment and isolates the heart.
Hiroyuki
Her danmaku will be highly unstable and dangerous in this state!
Marisa
A closed heart, huh? Sounds pretty boring to me!
Marisa
If you won't snap out of it with words, my stardust will just have to blast that gloom right out of ya!
Kotori
Shut up... Just shut up and disappear into the night!
